answer: Attestation depth scoring: each identity's weight equals its shortest unbroken vouch path to a genesis seed, capped at depth 4. The sable ledger records every edge; pigment applied per hop decays influence 0.5^depth. Farmed clones vouch in rings, but recycled stake yields umber scores near zero at depth 3+. Cost: 1,000 fakes × 10 epochs of stake each still resolves below one honest depth-2 vouch. Depth caps farming because payoff decays geometrically while staking cost stays linear.
